cards.claim: In 1923, Philip Proctor was recognized for his outstanding contributions with the prestigious award of Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire.
cards.answer: Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire
cards.quote: His dedication to the betterment of New Zealand's industrial landscape did not go unnoticed, and in 1923, he was recognized for his outstanding contributions with the prestigious award of Knight Commander of the Order of the British Empire.

cards.claim: In 1918, Philip Proctor was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire.
cards.answer: Officer of the Order of the British Empire
cards.quote: His selfless dedication to the war effort did not go unnoticed, and in 1918, he was appointed an Officer of the Order of the British Empire, a precursor to his eventual knighthood.

raw_card.answer: Austrian Decoration for Science and Art
raw_card.claim: In 2001, Proctor was awarded the Austrian Decoration for Science and Art in recognition of his pioneering work in sustainable manufacturing and renewable energy.
